Academic Context  
Mei-Lin and I collaborated on a project refining API test suites for a client’s logistics platform. Her ability to distill complex system behaviors into targeted test cases stood out. She documented edge cases that others overlooked, which later saved the team 12 hours of debugging.  

Working Relationship  
We’ve worked closely on three projects, including a high-priority bug hunt during a product launch. Mei-Lin’s calm under pressure and knack for prioritizing critical issues helped us meet deadlines. She often shared insights on improving test coverage, which we adopted across the team.  

Research Ability  
Mei-Lin’s Python scripts for automating regression tests reduced manual efforts by 30% in our last sprint. She also built a framework for monitoring API response times, which became a standard tool. Her attention to detail ensures even minor deviations are flagged early.  

Broader Strengths  
Beyond technical skills, Mei-Lin’s reliability and curiosity make her a great collaborator. She’ll spend extra time mentoring junior team members or refining test scripts to handle edge cases. Her work ethic ensures tasks are completed with precision and care.  

Recommendation  
Mei-Lin’s combination of technical sharpness and dedication makes her a strong fit for any team. She consistently delivers high-quality results while fostering a supportive environment. I’d welcome the opportunity to collaborate again.
